definitions: A path or road, often unpaved or rough, made by the passage of people, animals, or vehicles.
A continuous line of rails on which a train runs.
A mark or line of marks left by a person, animal, or vehicle in passing.
A distinct section of a musical recording.
A course or route followed or to be followed.
examples: The muddy track led to the farm.
The train was delayed due to a problem on the track.
We followed the deer tracks in the snow.
This album has some great tracks.
The project is back on track.
